40016347.author: पदार्थः
40016347.content: राक्षससैन्यपाले commander in chief of the army, तस्मिन् in that, युद्धे war, प्लवङ्गमानाम् ऋषभेण bull of the Vanaras, Neela निहते has been killed, भीमायुधम् with dreadful weapons, सागरतुल्यवेगम् like the ocean in fury, राक्षसराजसैन्यम् Rakshasa king's army, विदुद्रुवे ran.

40016347.author: Translation
40016347.content: Commander in chief of the Rakshasa army killed by Neela, the bull of Vanaras, the army Rakshasas with dreadful weapons which were like the fury of an ocean, ran.

40016348.author: पदार्थः
40016348.content: अथ and then, गत्वा having gone, सेनापतिम् commander in chief, पावकसूनुशस्तम् son of firegod killed, रक्षोधिपतेः king of Rakshasas, शशंसुः the survivors, रक्षोधिपः king of Rakshasas, तेषाम् in that way, तत् thereafter, वचनम् words, निशम्य revealed, क्रोधवशम् under the spell of anger, जगाम became.

40016348.author: Translation
40016348.content: Having gone to the king of Rakshasas, the survivors said, "Prahastha is killed by the son of fire god." Thereafter, the king of Rakshasas fell prey to anger.

40016349.author: पदार्थः
40016349.content: सङ् ख्ये relating to, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, निहतम् death, निशम्य revealed, शोकार्दितः sorrowful, क्रोधपरीतचेताः tormented with anger, इन्द्रः Indra, निर्जरयोथमुख्याविव commanders of celestial troops, तान् to them, राक्षसयूथमुख्यान् to the Rakshasa troops, उवाच said.

40016349.author: Translation
40016349.content: Even as Rakshasas revealed about Prahastha's death, tormented by grief and anger Ravana spoke to Rakshasa troops just as Indra spoke to celestial troops.

40016350.author: पदार्थः
40016350.content: इन्द्रबलसादनः one who is capable of destroying Indra's army, सानुयात्रः followers, सकुञ्जरः elephants, मेसैन्यपालः my commander in chief, यैः he who, सूदितः capable of killing, रिपवे with regard to enemy, अवज्ञा low opinion, नकार्या not to think.

40016350.author: Translation
40016350.content: "No low opinion to be entertained with regard to an enemy by whom my commander in chief of the army was killed, who is capable of killing the army of Indra with his followers and elephants."

40016351.author: पदार्थः
40016351.content: सः he अहम् I, अविचारयन् without thinking, रिपुविनाशाय to put an end to the enemy, विजयाय for success, अद्भुतम् wonderful, तत् that, रणशीर्षम् battle scene, स्वयमेव I shall myself, गमिष्यामि will go.

40016351.author: Translation
40016351.content: "I shall go myself without thinking to that wonderful battle scene and put an end to the enemy and succeed."

40016352.author: पदार्थः
40016352.content: अद्य now, तत् that, वानरानीकम् army of Vanaras, सहलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, रामंच and Rama, दीप्स्सैः burn, अनगिभिः without the use of fire, वनमिव like a forest, बाणौघैः with streams of arrows, निर्धहिष्यामि burn up.

40016352.author: Translation
40016352.content: "Now I will go and burn up that army of Vanaras along with Lakshmana and Rama with the stream of my arrows just as forest fire without the use of fire."

40016353.author: पदार्थः
40016353.content: अमरराजशत्रुः enemy of king of Devatas, सः he, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, ज्वलनप्रकाशम् luminous like fire, तुरङ्गोत्तमराजयुक्तम् yoked to the best of horses, प्रकाशमानम् blazing, वपुषा by virtue of its form (golden), ज्वलन्तम् shining, रथम् chariot, समारुरोह ascended.

40016353.author: Translation
40016353.content: Ravana, the enemy of the king of Devatas, having spoken like that ascended a chariot yoked to the best of horses, shining by virtue of its form (golden) and luminous like fire.

40016354.author: पदार्थः
40016354.content: तदा then, राक्षसराजमुख्यः foremost king of the Rakshasas, सः he, शङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादैः blast of conchs, beat of drums, and clapping of arms अस्फोटितक्षेळ्वितसिंहनादैः clapping of arms and sounds like the roar of a lion, पुण्यैः chanting sounds of agreeable verses, स्तवैश्चापि eulogizing, अभिपूज्यमानः honoured very highly, ययौ went forth.

40016354.author: Translation
40016354.content: As the foremost king of the Rakshasas went forth, a blast of sounds of conchs, beat of drums and clapping of arms and the roaring sounds followed by the chanting of auspicious verses sung by the Rakshasas eulogizing and honouring the king highly.

40016355.author: पदार्थः
40016355.content: शैलजीमून्तिकाशरूपैः by forms that resembled mountains and clouds, पावक दीप्तनेत्रैः whose eyes were like fire, मांसाशनैः flesh eaters, सः he, राक्षसराजमुख्यः Rakshasa king, भूतैः by Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded, असुरेशः asuras, रुद्रुःइव like Rudra, बभौ seemed.

40016355.author: Translation
40016355.content: The Rakshasa king surrounded by Rakshasas who resembled mountains and clouds in form seemed like Rudra surrounded by asuras.

40016356.author: पदार्थः
40016356.content: ततः thereafter, महौजाः possessed with great splendour, सहसा forcibly, नगर्याः at the city, निष्क्रम्य stopped, उग्रम् in front, महार्णवाभ्रस्तनितम् resembling great ocean and cloud, समुद्यतम् collected together, पादपशैलहस्तम् taking trees and rocks, तत् वानरसैन्यम् the Vanara army, ददर्श saw.

40016356.author: Translation
40016356.content: Thereafter, Ravana possessed with great splendour stopped at the city and saw the army of Vanaras collected together looking like an ocean of clouds wielding trees and rocks.

40016357.author: पदार्थः
40016357.content: भुजगेन्द्रबाहुः whose arms are like king of serpents (smooth and strong), सेवानुगतः followed by army, पृथुश्रीः shining with splendour, रामः Rama, अतिप्रचण्डम् exceedingly furious, तत् that, राक्षसानीकम् Rakshasa army, आलोक्य seeing, शस्त्रभृताम् wielder of weapons, वरिष्ठम् foremost, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, उवाच spoke.

40016357.author: Translation
40016357.content: Rama, whose arms were like the king of serpents, shining with splendour, followed by army, seeing the army of Rakshasas exceedingly furious, spoke to Vibheeshana the foremost of the wielder of weapons.

40016358.author: पदार्थः
40016358.content: नानापताकध्वजशस्त्रजुष्टम् several kinds of flags, posts and weapons, प्रासासिशूलायुथवज्रजुष्टम् armed with missiles, tridents, and weapons like darts, swords and spikes, अभीरुजुष्टम् unshakeable, महेन्द्रोपमनागजुष्टम् elephants of the size of Mahendra mountain, अक्षोभ्यम् soldiers, इदम् this, सैन्यम् army, कस्य whose.

40016358.author: Translation
40016358.content: "Under whose command is this unshakeable army with several kinds of flags, posts and weapons armed with missiles, tridents, swords spikes and darts, with elephants the size of Mahendra mountain"

40016359.author: पदार्थः
40016359.content: ततः thereupon, शक्रसमानवीर्यः hero equal to Indra, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, रामस्य Rama's, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य on hearing, महात्मनाम् great soul, राक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् among the Rakshasa leaders, बलप्रवेगम् endowed with great strength, रामस्य to Rama, शशंस revealed.

40016359.author: Translation
40016359.content: Thereupon, Vibheeshana, equal to Indra in valour, on hearing the great soul Rama, revealed about the Rakshasa army endowed with great strength.

40016360.author: पदार्थः
40016360.content: राजन् king!, गजस्कन्धगतः by whom seated on the elephant, is shaking (by his weight) the elephant's head, नवोदितार्कोपमताम्रवक्त्रः coppery face resembles rising Sun, महात्मा great, यःअसौ he who, नागशिरः mounted on elephant, संकम्पयन् Akampana, अभ्युपैति gigantic, एनम् he is, अकम्पनम् Akampana, अवेहि know.

40016360.author: Translation
40016360.content: "O King! the one seated on the elephant, by whose weight the elephant head is shaking, whose coppery face is like the rising sun, a gigantic one is Akampana."

40016361.author: पदार्थः
40016361.content: रथस्थः from the chariot, मृगराजकेतुः distinguished by the sign of lion, शक्रधनुःप्रकाशम् splendid as the bow of Indra, धनुः bow, धुन्वन् making sound, यःअसौ he who, उग्रविवृत्तदंष्ट्रः with terrific teeth projected forward, करीव elephant, भाति looks like, सः he, वरप्रधानः eminent by the boons bestowed, इन्द्रजित् नाम Indrajith by name.

40016361.author: Translation
40016361.content: "The one on the chariot, distinguished by the sign of a lion, and making sound with his bow, splendid as Indra's bow with terrific teeth projected forward looks like an elephant, eminent by virtue of the boons bestowed is Indrajith by name."

40016362.author: पदार्थः
40016362.content: व्निध्यास्तमहेन्द्रकल्पः resembles Vindhya mountain in the west and Mahendra mountain, धन्वी stretching his bow and making sound, रथस्थः from the chariot, अतिरथः great chariot warrior, अतिवीरः great hero, अतुल्यमानम् unequalled in size, चापम् bow, विष्पारयन् yonder, अतिविवृद्धकायः body grown out of size, यःएषः he in that way, अयम् coming in sight, नाम्ना named, अतिकायः Atikaya.

40016362.author: Translation
40016362.content: "He who resembles Vindhya Mountain in the west (where the sun sets) and the Mahendra mountain (in size) seated on the chariot, is a great chariotwarrior, a hero unequalled in size, wielding a bow whose body is grown out of size, who is coming in sight is by name Atikaya."

40016363.author: पदार्थः
40016363.content: नवार्कोदितताम्रचक्षुः whose eyes are coppery red in anger, यःअसौ he Oh!, घण्टनिनदप्रणादम् whose trumpeting resembles beating of bells, गजम् elephant, आरुह्य mounted, खरम् harsh, गर्जति roars, महात्मा great, सःएषःवीरः he in that way a courageous one, महोदरोनाम by name Mahodara.

40016363.author: Translation
40016363.content: "He whose eyes are coppery red in anger, who rides on elephant resembles the beating of bells, roars in harsh tone are a great courageous one by the name Mahodara."

40016364.author: पदार्थः
40016364.content: सन्ध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशम् shining like a mountain crowned with cloud, यः he, असौ Oh!, काञ्चनचित्रभाण्डम् decorated with gold jewels, हयम् horses, आरुह्य mounted, मरीचिनद्धम् radiant like the Sun, प्रासम् holding the yoke, समुद्यम्य ascended, एषः in that way, अशनितुल्यवेगः of high speed, पिशाचः Pisacha.

40016364.author: Translation
40016364.content: "He who is mounted on horses decorated with gold shining, like a mountain crowned with cloud, radiant as the Sun holding the shining yokes coming at high speed is by name Pisacha."

40016365.author: पदार्थः
40016365.content: यःएषः he in that way, निशितम् firmly, विद्युत्प्रभम् shining like lightning, किङ्करवज्रवेगम् surpassing the thunderbolt in speed, शूलम् trident, प्रगृह्य seizing, गिरिप्रकाशम् shining like mountain, वृषेन्द्रम् Lordly bull, आरुह्य riding, आयाति coming, सःअसौ he is, यशस्वी famous, यः he, त्रिशिराः Trisira.

40016365.author: Translation
40016365.content: "He who comes firmly shining like lightning, surpassing thunderbolt in speed, seizing a trident, riding a Lordly bull shining like a mountain is the famous Trisira."

40016366.author: पदार्थः
40016366.content: जीमूतनिकाशरूपः in the form of cloud, पृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः of fleshy well shaped broad chest, समाहितः fully prepared, पन्नगराजकेतुः with the sign of the king of serpents, असौ he is, कुम्भं Kumbha, धनुः bow, विधून्वन् , विष्पारयन् stretching, याति there comes.

40016366.author: Translation
40016366.content: "There comes Kumbha whose form is like a cloud in form, whose chest is fleshy and broad. He is fully prepared, coming with a sign of the king of serpents (Vasuki) stretching his bow."

40016367.author: पदार्थः
40016367.content: यःएषः he in that way, जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टम् studded with gold and diamonds, दीप्तम् shining, सधूमम् smoky, परिघम् iron club, प्रगृह्य seizing, आयाति comes, सःअसौ he is, रक्षोबलकेतुभूतः chief of all Rakshasa army, अद्भुतघोरकर्मा capable of wonderful and terrible deeds, निकुम्भः Nikumbha.

40016367.author: Translation
40016367.content: "There comes Nikumbha, studded with gold and diamonds, shining and smoky, who is the chief of Rakshasa army seizing an iron club, is capable of wonderful and terrific deeds."

40016368.author: पदार्थः
40016368.content: चापासिशरौघजुष्टम् with multitude of swords and arrows, पताकिनम् with flags, पावकदीप्तरूपम् blazing like fire, रथम् chariot, समास्थाय mounted on, यःएषः he that way, विभाति glorious, उदग्रः on top, असौ he is, नगशृङ्गयोधी fights with mountain peaks, नरान्तकः Naranthaka.

40016368.author: Translation
40016368.content: Again, comes Naranthaka, with multitude of swords and arrows, mounted on top of a chariot with flags, blazing like fire, who fights with mountain peaks.

40016369.author: पदार्थः
40016369.content: यःएषः he that way, नानाविधघोररूपैः surrounded by several hideous forms, व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगाश्ववक्स्रैः heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants, deer and horses, विवृत्तनेत्रैः rolling eyes, भूतैः ghosts, वृतः surrounded, भाति remains, सःअसौ he is, सुराणामपि even for Devatas, दर्पहन्ता humbles pride, एषः that way, महात्मा great, रक्षोधिपतिः king of Rakshasas, इन्दुप्रतिमम् like moon, सूक्ष्मशलाकम् white canopy, अग्य्रम् slender, सितम् ribs, छत्रम् umbrella, यत्र there, विभाति shines, अत्र there, भूतैः beings, वृतः surrounded, रुद्रःइव like Rudra, विभाति shines.

40016369.author: Translation
40016369.content: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."

40016370.author: पदार्थः
40016370.content: यःएषः he that way, नानाविधघोररूपैः surrounded by several hideous forms, व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगाश्ववक्स्रैः heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants, deer and horses, विवृत्तनेत्रैः rolling eyes, भूतैः ghosts, वृतः surrounded, भाति remains, सःअसौ he is, सुराणामपि even for Devatas, दर्पहन्ता humbles pride, एषः that way, महात्मा great, रक्षोधिपतिः king of Rakshasas, इन्दुप्रतिमम् like moon, सूक्ष्मशलाकम् white canopy, अग्य्रम् slender, सितम् ribs, छत्रम् umbrella, यत्र there, विभाति shines, अत्र there, भूतैः beings, वृतः surrounded, रुद्रःइव like Rudra, विभाति shines.

40016370.author: Translation
40016370.content: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."

40016371.author: पदार्थः
40016371.content: किरीटी decked with crown, चलकुण्डलास्यः countenance with hanging earrings, नगेन्द्रविन्ध्योपमभीमकायः of terrible form like Himalayas and Vindhya, महेन्द्रवैवस्वतदर्पहन्ता who has humbled the pride of Mahendra and Yama, रक्षोधिपः king of Rakshasas, सूर्यःइव like Sun, अवभाति shining.

40016371.author: Translation
40016371.content: "There is the king of Rakshasas shining like Sun, whose countenance shines with hanging earrings, of terrible form like the Himalayas and Vindhya, who has humbled the pride of Mahendra and Yama."

40016372.author: पदार्थः
40016372.content: ततः then, अरिन्दमः scourge of enemies, रामः Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied, अहो Oh, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, दीप्तमहातेजाः endowed with great luminous glory.

40016372.author: Translation
40016372.content: Then Rama the scourge of enemies replied Vibheeshana, "Oh! Ravana! King of Rakshasas is endowed with luminous glory."

40016373.author: पदार्थः
40016373.content: रावणः Ravana, रश्मिभिः blazing, आदित्यःइव like the Sun, दुष्प्रेक्ष्य difficult to gaze, भाति shining, अस्य his, तेजःसमावृतम् brilliance spread all over, रूपम् form, सुव्यक्तम् to discern, लक्ष्यतेहि not perceptible.

40016373.author: Translation
40016373.content: "Ravana blazing like the sun is difficult to gaze even. His shine is spread all over and not perceptible to discern."

40016374.author: पदार्थः
40016374.content: देवदावनवीराणाम् among the Devas and Danavas, वपुः brilliance, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Ravana's, एतत् such, वपुः brilliance, यादृशम् , प्रकाशते shines, एवंविधम् like this, नभवेत् not brightly.

40016374.author: Translation
40016374.content: Among the Devas and Danavas such brilliance is not there. He shines so brightly.

40016375.author: पदार्थः
40016375.content: महोजस: great warriors, अस्य of him, योधाः in war, सर्वे all, पर्वतसङ्काशाः like mountain, सर्वे all, पर्वतयोधिनः fight with mountains, सर्वे all, दीप्तायुधधराः glowing weapons.

40016375.author: Translation
40016375.content: "The great warriors of Ravana fighting in war are like mountains and all fought with mountains and glowing weapons."

40016376.author: पदार्थः
40016376.content: प्रदीप्त्तै: shining brilliance, भीमविक्रमैः of terrible valour, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, देहवद्भिः furious forms, परिवृत surrounded by, भूतैः beings, असौ oh, रक्षोराजः Rakshasa king, अन्तकःइव like god of death, भाति shining.

40016376.author: Translation
40016376.content: "The Rakshasa king is surrounded by sharp, furious beings of terrible valour shining like the god of death."

40016377.author: पदार्थः
40016377.content: दिष्ट्या by good luck, पापात्मा sinful, अयम् he, मम my, दृष्टिपथम् my sight, गतः gone, अद्य come, सीताहरणसम्भवम् Sita's abduction, क्रोधम् wrath, विमोक्ष्यामि give vent.

40016377.author: Translation
40016377.content: "By his good luck, this sinful one has come under my sight. I will give vent to my wrath born of Sita's abduction."

40016378.author: पदार्थः
40016378.content: वीर्यवान् indomitable, रामः Rama, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, धनुः bow, आदाय taking out, शरोत्तमम् excellent, समुद्धृत्य got ready, लक्ष्मणानुचरः Lakshmana as follower, तस्थौ stood.

40016378.author: Translation
40016378.content: Indomitable Rama having spoken in that manner, followed by Lakshmana got ready and took out an excellent bow and stood.

40016379.author: पदार्थः
40016379.content: ततः thereupon, महात्मा great soul, सः he, रक्षोधिपतिः Rakshasa king, महाबलानि strong army, तानि them, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, आह you, द्वारेषु at gates, चर्यागृहगोपुरेणु buildings on the four main streets, सुनिर्वृताः fully complacent, निर्विशङ्काः free from apprehension, तिष्ठत stationed.

40016379.author: Translation
40016379.content: There upon the great soul, the king of Rakshasas thus spoke to the strong army of Rakshasas, "Fully complacent, free from any apprehension be stationed at the gates and the buildings of the four main streets."

40016380.author: पदार्थः
40016380.content: भवद्भिः me also, सहितम् with you, माम् me, इह here, आगतम् coming to know my coming, इदम् this, छिद्रम् weak side, विदित्वा knowing, वनौकसः forest dwellers, समेताः together, दुष्प्रसहाम् enter, शून्याम् vacant, पुरीम् City, प्रमथ्य Devastate, सहसा united, प्रधर्षयेयुः storm.

40016380.author: Translation
40016380.content: "Coming to know that I am here with you, this side, considering it to be a weak point, the forest dwellers may enter the vacant city and Devastate all united."

40016381.author: पदार्थः
40016381.content: तान् them, सचिवान् counsellors, विसर्जयित्वा sent away, ततः there upon, रक्षःसु Rakshasa, यथानियोगम् as instructed, गतेषु having departed, वानरसागरौघम् ocean of Vanaras, महाझषः gigantic fish, पूर्णम् totally, अर्णवौघम् इव like the war in the ocean, व्यदारयत् pierced through.

40016381.author: Translation
40016381.content: After the counsellors departed from there Ravana pierced through the ocean of Vanaras just as gigantic fish would pierce in the sea.

40016382.author: पदार्थः
40016382.content: युधि on the battlefield, सहसा speedily, आपतन्तम् advancing suddenly, दीप्तेषुचापम् with radiant bow, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, समीक्ष्य watching, हरीशः monkey, महत् great, महीधराग्रम् huge mountain top, समुत्पाट्य lifting up, रक्षोधिपतिम् towards Rakshasa king, दुद्राव went.

40016382.author: Translation
40016382.content: Watching Ravana advancing suddenly on the battlefield with great speed, Sugriva took a huge mountain top and went towards Rakshasa king.

40016383.author: पदार्थः
40016383.content: बहुवृक्षसानुम् whose slopes were crowded with many trees, तत् that, शैलशृङ्गम् mountain top, प्रगृह्य seizing, निशाचराय at night rangers, चिक्षेप hurled, आपतन्तम् towards, तम् him, समीक्ष्य watching, सहसा quickly, तपनीयपुङ्खैः arrows with gold shafts, बाणैः arrows, चिच्छेद broke.

40016383.author: Translation
40016383.content: Seizing mountain tops whose slopes were filled with trees Sugriva hurled at the night rangers. Watching this Ravana quickly broke them with his arrows fixed with golden shafts.

40016384.author: पदार्थः
40016384.content: तस्मिन् in that, प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे slope covered with excellent trees, शृङ्गे peak, विदीर्णे broken, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, पतिते fallen, राक्षसलोकनाथः king of Rakshasa world, महाहिकल्पम् arranging for destruction, अन्तकाभम् like the spirit of death, शरम् arrow, समादधे got ready.

40016384.author: Translation
40016384.content: After that slope covered with excellent trees had fallen on the ground and broken, Ravana got readied with an arrow as if for arranging destruction like the spirit of death.

40016385.author: पदार्थः
40016385.content: रुष्टः angry, सः he, अनिलतुल्यवेगम् like the wind in speed, सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् shone like sparks of fire, महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगम् vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, तंबाणम् that arrow, गृहीत्वा seizing, सुग्रीववधाय for the destruction of Sugriva, चिक्षेप released.

40016385.author: Translation
40016385.content: Seizing an arrow which shone like sparks of fire and had the speed of wind, nay vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, he (Ravana) released an arrow in anger.

40016386.author: पदार्थः
40016386.content: रावणबाहुमुक्तः released from Ravana's arms, सःसायकः that arrow, शक्रशनिप्रख्यवपुः hard and sharp like Indra's thunderbolt, शिताग्रः sharp thorn edged spear, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, आसाद्य reaching, गुहेरिता like Guha's, उग्रशक्तिः fierce, क्रौञ्चमिव Krauncha like, वेगात् violently, बिभेद pierced.

40016386.author: Translation
40016386.content: That arrow released from Ravana's arm, which was hard and sharp as the thunderbolt of Indra, pierced Sugriva just as the sharp thorn edged spear of Guha penetrated Krauncha mountain.

40016387.author: पदार्थः
40016387.content: सःवीरः that hero, सायकार्तः hurt by arrow, विपरीतचेताः lost sense, कूजन् groaning, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, निपपात fell, युधि in battle, विसंज्ञम् sent forth, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen, तम् they, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, यातुधानाः an evil spirit, प्रहृष्टाः joyfully, नेदुः shouted.

40016387.author: Translation
40016387.content: That hero (Sugriva) hurt by the arrow lost senses and fell on the ground groaning in the battlefield. Seeing that the Rakshasas shouted joyfully overtaken by evil spirits.

40016388.author: पदार्थः
40016388.content: ततः thereafter, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, सुदंष्ट्र Sudamshtra, अथ and, ऋषभः Rshaba, ज्योतिमुखः Jyothimukha, नलश्च Nala, शैलान् rock, समुत्पाट्य taking mountains, विवृद्धकायाः raising their body size, तम् they, राक्षसेन्द्रंप्रति over the king of Rakshasas, प्रदुद्रुवुः rushed.

40016388.author: Translation
40016388.content: Thereafter Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sudamshtra, Rshaba, Jyothimukha and Nala increasing their body size rushed towards the king of Rakshasas.

40016389.author: पदार्थः
40016389.content: सःरक्षोधिपः the Rakshasa Lord, शिताग्रैः mountain peaks, बाणशतैः hundreds of arrows, तेषाम् by that, प्रहारान् released, मोघान् useless, चकार resist, जाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः arrows with golden shafts, बाणजालैः streams of arrows, तान् them, वानरेन्द्रानपि even Vanara king, बिभेद struck.

40016389.author: Translation
40016389.content: The Rakshasa Lord made the mountain peaks useless by the hundreds of arrows released by him. The streams of arrows with golden shafts could resist the Rakshasas and strike the Vanara king.

40016390.author: पदार्थः
40016390.content: भीमकायाः fierce form, तेवानरेन्द्राः of that Vanara leaders, त्रिदशारिबाणैः in the three directions, भिन्नाः torn, भुवि ground, निपेतुः fell, ततः that, सः he, बाणजालैः streams of arrows, उग्रम् sharp, तत् वानरसैन्यम् the army of Vanaras, प्रच्छादयामास covered.

40016390.author: Translation
40016390.content: The Vanara leaders of fierce form torn by the streams of sharp arrows discharged in the three directions fell covering the ground.

40016391.author: पदार्थः
40016391.content: वध्यमानाः those struck, पतिताः fallen, नावद्यमानाः shrieking, भयशल्यविद्धाः fear of pain by piercing, प्रवीराः heroes, तेशाखामृगाः the monkeys, रावणसायकार्ताः pressed by Ravana's arrows, शरण्यम् refuge रामम् Rama, शरणंजुग्मुः went to seek refuge.

40016391.author: Translation
40016391.content: Those monkeys struck and fallen by the piercing of arrows shrieking went to seek refuge from Rama.

40016392.author: पदार्थः
40016392.content: ततः that, महात्मा great soul, धनुष्मान् holding bow, सःरामः that Rama, धनुः bow, आदाय taking, सहसा immediately, जगाम went, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तम् him, अभ्युपेत्य addressed, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, परमार्थयुक्तम् consonant with truth, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoken.

40016392.author: Translation
40016392.content: The great soul Rama who was holding a bow went seizing it. Lakshmana approached him immediately with folded hands and addressed Rama with words consonant with truth.

40016393.author: पदार्थः
40016393.content: दुरात्मनः evil minded, अस्य his, वधाय destruction, आर्यः noble, सुपर्याप्तःकामम् complete the task, विभो glory, अहम् I, एतम् thus, विधमिष्यामि will exterminate, माम् me, अनुजानीहि I may be permitted.

40016393.author: Translation
40016393.content: "I will exterminate the evil minded Ravana. Oh! noble brother, may I be permitted to complete the task"

40016394.author: पदार्थः
40016394.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, सत्यपराक्रमः truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, महातेजाः highly energetic, रामः Rama, तम् to him, अब्रवीत् said, गच्छ going, संयुगे in the battle, यत्नपरश्चापि be careful, भव you.

40016394.author: Translation
40016394.content: Sri Rama, who was highly energetic and truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, told Lakshmana, "You go and be careful in the battle."

40016395.author: पदार्थः
40016395.content: रावणः Ravana, महावीर्यंरणे is a great hero in the battle, अद्भुतपराक्रमः wonderful valour, संक्रुद्धः angry, त्रैलोक्येनापि in the three worlds, दुष्प्रसह्यः difficult to resist, संशयः doubt, न not.

40016395.author: Translation
40016395.content: "Ravana is a great hero in the battlefield. His valour in war is wonderful. He is angry but none can withstand him in the three worlds."

40016396.author: पदार्थः
40016396.content: तस्य his, छिद्राणि arrows, मार्गस्व in the direction of, स्वच्छिद्राणि your arrows, लक्ष्य aim, समाहितः being alert, चक्षुषा your sight, धनुषा bow, यत्ना making effort, आत्मानम् yourself.

40016396.author: Translation
40016396.content: "Remaining alert, apply your arrows in the direction of his arrows. Looking at his arrows carefully, making an effort to protect yourself, set your bow."

40016397.author: पदार्थः
40016397.content: सौमित्रिः son of Sumitra, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सपरिष्वज्य embracing, अभिपूज्य offering prayers, तं that, रामम् Rama, अभिवाद्यच paying respects, अहवम् for encounter, ययौ sallied forth.

40016397.author: Translation
40016397.content: On hearing Raghava's words, son of Sumitra embraced him and offered prayers, paying respects sallied forth for the encounter.

40016398.author: पदार्थः
40016398.content: सः he, वारणहस्तबाहुम् endowed with elephant trunk like round shoulders, भीमोद्यतदीप्तचापम् fierce bow glowing, भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् broken bodies of Vanaras spread over, तान् them, वानरान् Vanaras, शरवृष्टिजालैः showering net of arrows, प्रच्छादयन्तम् instigating, रावणम् Ravana, ददर्श saw.

40016398.author: Translation
40016398.content: He saw Ravana, endowed with round shoulders like elephant trunks, with fierce bow glowing and the broken bodies of Vanaras spread all over. Ravana was showering nets of arrows and instigating vanaras.

40016399.author: पदार्थः
40016399.content: महातेजाः very brilliant, मारुतात्मजः son of wind god, सः he, हनूमान् Hanuman, तम् him, आलोक्य seeing, शरजालानि stream of arrows, निवार्य obstructing, रावणम् Ravana, प्रदुद्राव darted towards.

40016399.author: Translation
40016399.content: The son of the wind god, Hanuman, a brilliant one seeing Ravana, obstructed the stream of arrows and darted towards him.

40016400.author: पदार्थः
40016400.content: धीमान् courageous, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्य his, रथम् chariot, समासाद्य approaching near, दक्षिणम् right, बाहुम् arm, उद्यम्य lifting, त्रासयन् menacing, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016400.author: Translation
40016400.content: Courageous Hanuman seeing the chariot of Ravana lifting his right arm menacing him spoke these words.

40016401.author: पदार्थः
40016401.content: देवदावनगन्धर्वैः gods, demons and Gandharvas, सहराक्षसैः along with Rakshasas, यक्षैश्च Yakshas also, अवश्यंतु surely, त्वया by you, भग्ना death, ते to you, वानरेभ्यस्तु from Vanaras also, भयम् fear.

40016401.author: Translation
40016401.content: "Your life is surely secure from gods, demons, Gandharvas and Yakshas and Rakshasas but you fear Vanaras."

40016402.author: पदार्थः
40016402.content: मे I, पञ्चशाखः five branches, एषः that way, समुद्यतः together, दक्षिणःबाहुः right arm, ते to you, देहात् body, चिरोषितम् for long, भूतात्मानम् subtle body, विधमिष्यति will expel.

40016402.author: Translation
40016402.content: "I raised this right arm that way with five branches (five fingers) at you that will expel your subtle self (made up of the five subtle elements) from your body."

40016403.author: पदार्थः
40016403.content: भीमविक्रमः truly fierce, रावणः Ravana, हनुमतः Hanuman's, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, क्रोधात् in anger, संरक्तनयनः with blood red eyes, इदम् thus, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016403.author: Translation
40016403.content: Ravana of truly fierce valour, hearing Hanuman's words, his eyes became blood red and spoke to Hanuman this way.

40016404.author: पदार्थः
40016404.content: वानर Vanara, निःशङ्कम् without any hesitation, क्षिप्रम् at once, प्रहर go about, स्थिराम् permanent, कीर्तिम् fame, अवाप्नुहि will attain, ततः thereafter, ज्ञातविक्रान्तम् knowing your prowess, त्वाम् you, नाशयिष्यामि shall destroy.

40016404.author: Translation
40016404.content: "O Vanara! Go about without any hesitation. Attain the fame of a Vanara hitting Ravana permanently. Thereafter knowing your prowess, I shall put an end to you."

40016405.author: पदार्थः
40016405.content: रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, वायुसूनुः son of wind god, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke, मया by me, पूर्वम् earlier, प्रहृतम् killed, तवसुतम् your son, अक्षम् Akshaya, तव your.

40016405.author: Translation
40016405.content: Having heard Ravana's words, Hanuman said, "Think of your son Akshaya killed by me earlier."

40016406.author: पदार्थः
40016406.content: एवम् that manner, उक्तः having spoken, महातेजाः highly energetic, वीर्यवान् valiant, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa Lord, रावणः Ravana, अनिलसुतम् son of wind god, तलेन with hand, उरसि on the chest, आजघान slapped.

40016406.author: Translation
40016406.content: Having spoken that way by Hanuman, the Lord of Rakshasas slapped his hand on Hanuman's chest.

40016407.author: पदार्थः
40016407.content: तेन by him, तलाभिहतः smacked by, सः he (Hanuman), मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, चचालच with hand, तेजस्वी brilliant, महामतिः intellectual, मुहूर्तम् for a minute, स्थित्वा stood firm, स्थैर्यम् picking up courage, अभि very, कृत्वा did, सङ्कृद्धः enraged, तलेनैव with his palm, अमरद्विषम् enemy of gods, आजघान struck.

40016407.author: Translation
40016407.content: Smacked by him (Ravana), Hanuman, a brilliant and intelligent one stood firm for a while and picking up courage, highly enraged struck the enemy of gods with his palm.

40016408.author: पदार्थः
40016408.content: ततः thereupon, महात्मना great soul, तेनवानरेण by the Vanara, अभिहतः struck, दशग्रीवः ten headed, भूमिचले shaken like an earthquake, अचलःयथा like mountain, समाधूतः shaken together, तते afterwards.

40016408.author: Translation
40016408.content: Thereupon, struck by the great soul, Vanara, the ten headed Ravana was shaken like the earthquake on the mountain together.

40016409.author: पदार्थः
40016409.content: सङ्ग्रामे in that war, तथा that way, तलताडितम् hit by hand, तंरावणम् that Ravana, दृष्टवा hard, ऋषयः sages, वानराः Vanara, सिद्धाः siddhas, असुरैःसह demons as well, देवा Devas, नेदुः shouted.

40016409.author: Translation
40016409.content: Ravana hit by hand in that way in a hard manner, the siddhas, demons as well and even Devatas raised their voice.

40016410.author: पदार्थः
40016410.content: अथ and then, महातेजाः extremely energetic, रावणः Ravana, आश्वास्य from breath, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, वानर Vanara, साधु well done, वीर्येण courageous, श्लाघनीय praise worthy, मेरिपुः my enemy, असि you are.

40016410.author: Translation
40016410.content: And thereafter, thus spoke extremely energetic Ravana recovering from breath, "Well done vanara. You are courageous and praiseworthy, my enemy!"

40016411.author: पदार्थः
40016411.content: रावणेन by Ravana, एवम् in that way, उक्तः spoken, मारुतिः Maruti, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, रावण Ravana, मम my, वीर्येण valour, धिक् अस्तु What a shame, यत् that, त्वम् your, जीवसि survived.

40016411.author: Translation
40016411.content: Ravana having spoken in that way, Maruti said "Oh Ravana! What a shame on my valour, you survived."

40016412.author: पदार्थः
40016412.content: दुर्भुद्धे evil minded, किंविकत्थसे why do you brag, इदानीम् like this, सकृत् once more you do, प्रहर strike, ततः then, मामिकः I will once again, मुष्टिः fist, त्वाम् you, यमक्षयम् to the abode of Yama, नयिष्यति I wish.

40016412.author: Translation
40016412.content: "O evil minded one, why do you brag You do this once more I will strike you once again with my fist and send you to the abode of Yama."

40016413.author: पदार्थः
40016413.content: ततः then, मारुतिवाक्येन consequent to Maruti's words, तदा then, तस्य his, कोधः anger, अज्वलत् burning, संरक्तनयनः red eyes, यत्नात् effort, दक्षिणम् right, मुष्टिम् fist, उद्यम्य lifting, वीर्यवान् powerful, वेगेन instantly, वानरोरपि Vanara's enemy, पातयामास brought down.

40016413.author: Translation
40016413.content: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.

40016414.author: पदार्थः
40016414.content: ततः then, मारुतिवाक्येन consequent to Maruti's words, तदा then, तस्य his, कोधः anger, अज्वलत् burning, संरक्तनयनः red eyes, यत्नात् effort, दक्षिणम् right, मुष्टिम् fist, उद्यम्य lifting, वीर्यवान् powerful, वेगेन instantly, वानरोरपि Vanara's enemy, पातयामास brought down.

40016414.author: Translation
40016414.content: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.

40016415.author: पदार्थः
40016415.content: व्यूढे hit, वक्षसि on chest, हनूमान् Hanuman, हतःपुनः again hurt, सञ्चचाल reeled, विह्वलम् overcome with fear, महाबलम् very powerful, तंहनूमन्तम् that Hanuman, दृष्टवा seeing, अतिरथः best charioteer, रथेन chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, नीलंप्रति towards Neela, समभ्यगात् drove.

40016415.author: Translation
40016415.content: Hit on his chest, Hanuman got hurt again and reeled. Seeing Hanuman's power, overcome with fear, the best charioteer Ravana drove quickly towards Neela.

40016416.author: पदार्थः
40016416.content: राक्षसानाम् for Rakshasas, अधिपतिः Lord, प्रतापवान् indomitable, दशग्रीवः ten headed, पन्नगप्रतिमैः resembling serpents, भीमैः dreadful, परमर्माभिभेदनैः which can pierce through vital parts, शरैः arrows, हरिचमूपतिम् leader of monkeys, नीलम् Nila, आदीपयामास began to strike.

40016416.author: Translation
40016416.content: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.

40016417.author: पदार्थः
40016417.content: राक्षसानाम् for Rakshasas, अधिपतिः Lord, प्रतापवान् indomitable, दशग्रीवः ten headed, पन्नगप्रतिमैः resembling serpents, भीमैः dreadful, परमर्माभिभेदनैः which can pierce through vital parts, शरैः arrows, हरिचमूपतिम् leader of monkeys, नीलम् Nila, आदीपयामास began to strike.

40016417.author: Translation
40016417.content: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.

40016418.author: पदार्थः
40016418.content: शरौघसमायस्तः pressurized by streams of arrows, कपिचमूपतिः monkey leader, सःनीलः that Nila, एकेन alone, करेण tearing up, शैलाग्रम् mountain peak, रक्षोधिपतये on the Rakshasa Lord, असृजत् hurled.

40016418.author: Translation
40016418.content: Pressured by the streams of arrows, the monkey leader, Neela single handed took up a peak of a mountain and hurled at the Lord of Rakshasas.

40016419.author: पदार्थः
40016419.content: तेजस्वी energetic, महामनाः great minded, हनूमानपि Hanuman, समाश्वस्तः became alert, युद्धेप्सुः seeking a fight, विप्रेक्षमाणः gazing, नीलेनसह Nila, संसक्तम् feeling fresh, राक्षसेश्वरम् to Rakshasa Lord, रावणम् Ravana, सरोषम् angrily, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, अन्येन with other, युध्यमानस्य doing a fight, अभिधावनम् attack, नयुक्तम् not correct.

40016419.author: Translation
40016419.content: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."

40016420.author: पदार्थः
40016420.content: तेजस्वी energetic, महामनाः great minded, हनूमानपि Hanuman, समाश्वस्तः became alert, युद्धेप्सुः seeking a fight, विप्रेक्षमाणः gazing, नीलेनसह Nila, संसक्तम् feeling fresh, राक्षसेश्वरम् to Rakshasa Lord, रावणम् Ravana, सरोषम् angrily, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, अन्येन with other, युध्यमानस्य doing a fight, अभिधावनम् attack, नयुक्तम् not correct.

40016420.author: Translation
40016420.content: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."

40016421.author: पदार्थः
40016421.content: अथ and then, महातेजाः endowed with extraordinary energy, रावणः Ravana, तंशृङ्गम् that peak, सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैः with sharp arrows, सप्तभिः seven, शरैः arrows, आजघान attacked, तत् then, विकीर्णं broken, पपातह fell.

40016421.author: Translation
40016421.content: Ravana, endowed with extraordinary energy attacked that peak hurled by Neela with seven sharp arrows and it fell broken into pieces.

40016422.author: पदार्थः
40016422.content: परवीरहा killer of stupendous foes, चमूपतिः leader, विकीर्णम् broken, तत् that, गिरेःशृङ्गम् mountain peak, दृष्टवा seeing, कोपेन in anger, कालानगिरिव like fire at the universal destruction, जज्वाल shone.

40016422.author: Translation
40016422.content: On seeing the crushed peak, Neela, the killer of stupendous foes, shone like fire at universal destruction in anger.

40016423.author: पदार्थः
40016423.content: सःनीलः that Neela, संयुगे in battle, अश्वकर्णान्धान् Aswakarana, शालान् Sala, सुपुष्पितान् in bloom, चूतानपि and Mango trees, अन्यान् and other, विविधान् several, वृक्षान् trees, चिक्षेप hurled.

40016423.author: Translation
40016423.content: In the battle Neela hurled Aswakarana, Sala and Mango trees in good bloom and several other trees at Ravana.

40016424.author: पदार्थः
40016424.content: सःरावणः that Ravana, तान् those, वृक्षान् trees, प्रतिसमासाद्य broke in return, चिच्छेद broke, घोरेण formidable, शरवर्षेण rain of arrows, पावकिम् on son of fire god (Neela), अभ्यवर्षच्छ rained.

40016424.author: Translation
40016424.content: Ravana broke those trees in return and showered rain of formidable arrows at Neela.

40016425.author: पदार्थः
40016425.content: शरौघेण hail of shafts, मेघेनेव by cloud, अभिवृष्टः when rained, महाबलः mighty strong, ततः that, रूपम् form, ह्रस्वम् small size, कृत्वा reducing, ध्वजाग्रे top of bow, निपपातह landed.

40016425.author: Translation
40016425.content: When Neela was covered by Ravana's arrows, it was just as clouds cover mountain peaks. Neela reduced his size and landed on top of Ravana's bow.

40016426.author: पदार्थः
40016426.content: ध्वजाग्रे on top of the post of bow, समवस्थितम् standing, पावकात्मजम् son of fire god, आलोक्य seeing, रावणः Ravana, क्रोधात् in anger, जज्वाल burning, ततः then, नीलः Neela, ननादच roared.

40016426.author: Translation
40016426.content: Neela stood on top of the post of the bow of Ravana. On seeing that Ravana was burning in anger while Neela roared.

40016427.author: पदार्थः
40016427.content: ध्वजाग्रे on top of bow, धनुषः unable to release the arrow from the bow, अग्रे top, किरीटाग्रेच on top of the crown, तंहरिम् that monkey, दृष्टवा seeing, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अथ and then, हनुमांश्च and Hanuman, रामश्च Rama, विस्मिताः amazed.

40016427.author: Translation
40016427.content: Then, when Ravana was unable to release the arrow from the bow on Neela, who was shifting from the top of the post to the crown. Seeing that Lakshmana, Rama and Hanuman were amazed.

40016428.author: पदार्थः
40016428.content: महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, रावणः Ravana, अपि also, कपिलाघवविस्मितः Nila's ability to move, दीप्तम् shining, अद्भुतम् wondered, आग्नेयम् shaft presided by fire god, अस्त्रम् , आहारयामास took up.

40016428.author: Translation
40016428.content: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy was also wonder struck at Neela's agility. Then he took up the shining shaft presided over by fire god.

40016429.author: पदार्थः
40016429.content: ततः thereafter, आहवे war, नीललाघवसम्भ्रान्तम् agitated about Neela's feats, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, लब्दलक्षाः having achieved their wish, तेप्लवङ्गमाः those monkeys, हृष्टाः cheerful, चुक्रुशुः shouted.

40016429.author: Translation
40016429.content: Thereafter, seeing Neela's feat in the war, Ravana was agitated and the Vanaras were cheerful for having achieved their wish and shouted in joy.

40016430.author: पदार्थः
40016430.content: तदा then, वानराणाम् Vanaras, नादेन clamour, संरब्धः provoked, रावणः Ravana, सम्फ्रमाविष्टहृदयः heart filled with anger, किञ्चित् a little, नप्रत्यपद्यत not know what to do in turn.

40016430.author: Translation
40016430.content: Provoked by the clamour of the vanaras, Ravana's heart was full of anger and did not know what to do.

40016431.author: पदार्थः
40016431.content: अध and then, निशाचरः night ranger, रावणः Ravana, आग्नेयेन arrow charged with fire, संयुक्तम् fitting, गृहीत्वा taking, ध्वजशीर्षस्थितम् resting on top of the bow, नीलम् Neela, उदैक्षत looked.

40016431.author: Translation
40016431.content: And then the night ranger Ravana taking up, fitting the arrow charged with fire, looked at Neela resting on top of the bow.

40016432.author: पदार्थः
40016432.content: ततः that, महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa Lord, रावणः Ravana, अब्रवीत् said, कपे oh monkey, परया Further, अनया unfair, मायया deceptive, लाघवयुक्तः very tricky, असि you are.

40016432.author: Translation
40016432.content: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy said, "Oh monkey, you are unfair, very tricky and further deceptive."

40016433.author: पदार्थः
40016433.content: वानर monkey, त्वम् your, अनेकशः many, तानितानि different, आत्मरूपाणि forms of you, सृजसि create, शक्तः have the ability, अपि also यदि which, जीवितम् life, रक्षस्वखलु save your life.

40016433.author: Translation
40016433.content: "Oh monkey! You are taking different forms and doing different deeds. If you have the ability, save your life."

40016434.author: पदार्थः
40016434.content: तथापि like that, मया by me, मुक्तः released, अस्त्रयोजितः charged with missile, सायकः arrow, जीवितम् life, परिरक्षन्तम् protecting, त्वाम् your, जीवितात् life, भ्रंशयिष्यति will destroy.

40016434.author: Translation
40016434.content: "The arrow released by me now is charged with a missile and will destroy your life. You have been protecting (changing your forms) your life."

40016435.author: पदार्थः
40016435.content: महाबाहुः broad shouldered, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, एवम् like that, उक्त्वा spoken, बाणम् arrow, अस्त्रण chanting the mantras, सन्धाय fixing the arrow, चमूपतिम् commander in chief, अताडयत् struck.

40016435.author: Translation
40016435.content: Speaking like that, Ravana, the king of Rakshasas chanting the mantras and fixing the arrow struck the commander in chief (Neela) of the Vanara army.

40016436.author: पदार्थः
40016436.content: सःनीलः that Neela, अस्त्रयुक्तेन struck by the arrow, बाणेन arrow, वक्षसि on the chest, ताडितः burnt, निर्धह्यमानः propelled by the missile, सहसा, महीतले on ground, निपपात fell.

40016436.author: Translation
40016436.content: Struck by the arrow propelled by the missile (of Ravana) on the chest, Neela fell on the ground.

40016437.author: पदार्थः
40016437.content: पितृमहात्म्यसंयोगात् by virtue of father's greatness, आत्मनः himself, तेजसाचापि own power, जानुभ्याम् knees, भूमौ to the ground, न्यपतत् fell, तु but, प्राणैः life, नव्ययुज्यत not ceased.

40016437.author: Translation
40016437.content: By virtue of his father's greatness and his own power, his life did not cease but he fell on the ground.

40016438.author: पदार्थः
40016438.content: दशग्रीवः ten headed, वानरम् at the Vanaras, विसंज्ञम् unconscious, दृष्टवा watching, रणोत्सुकः eager to fight, अम्बुदनादेन resembling the rattling sound of cloud, रथेन chariot, सौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, अभिदुद्रुवे went towards.

40016438.author: Translation
40016438.content: Finding the vanara unconscious the ten headed Ravana who was eager to fight went towards Saumithri in the chariot making sounds that resembled the sound of rattling of clouds.

40016439.author: पदार्थः
40016439.content: तम् him, मीदिनीम् as if the earth, रणमध्ये in the midst of war, आसाद्य reaching, वारयित्वा intercepting, स्थितः stood, ज्वलन् glowing, धनुः bow, कम्पयन्निव shaking.

40016439.author: Translation
40016439.content: In the midst of the battlefield stood Ravana, intercepting with his glowing bow making loud sounds as though shaking the earth.

40016440.author: पदार्थः
40016440.content: अदीनसत्त्वः not depressed in spirit, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, अप्रमेयम् immeasurable, धनुः bow, विष्फारयन्तम् stretching, तम् him, आह Oh, निशाचरेन्द्र Lord of night rangers, माम् me, अभ्येहि aware, त्वम् you, वानरान् Vanaras, प्रतियोद्धुम् fighting war, अर्हः you ought not.

40016440.author: Translation
40016440.content: Saumithri who was not depressed in spirit (by Ravana's attack) addressing Ravana who was stretching his bow said "Oh! Lord of night rangers, Be aware. You ought not to fight with vanaras."

40016441.author: पदार्थः
40016441.content: राजा king, सःरक्षः that Rakshasa, तस्य his, वाक्यम् words, प्रतिपूर्णघोषम् challenging statement, उग्रम् violent, ज्याशब्दम् vibrating sound, निशम्य hearing, उपस्थितम् standing near, तंसौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, आसाद्य reaching near, कोपान्वितम् wrathful, वाचम् words, उवाच spoke.

40016441.author: Translation
40016441.content: Hearing the challenging statement of the king of Rakshasas and hearing the vibrating sound, Saumithri standing close by spoke these wrathful words.

40016442.author: पदार्थः
40016442.content: राघव Raghava, विपरीतबुद्धिः perverted mind, अन्तगामी reaching the end, दिष्ट्या sight, मे my, दृष्टिमार्गम् my sight, प्राप्तः attained, मम me, बाणजालैः stream of arrows, संसाद्यमानः struck by my arrows, अस्मिन् you, क्षणे this very moment, मृत्युदेशम् abode of death, यास्यसि will go.

40016442.author: Translation
40016442.content: "Oh Raghava! You have come under the path of my sight. You are going to meet your end. You who are perverted in mind, struck by a stream of my arrows will reach the abode of death this very moment."

40016443.author: पदार्थः
40016443.content: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, अविस्मयानः not surprised, उद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् projected teeth, गर्जन्तम् screaming, तम् you, आह great, पापकृताम् sinful action, वरिष्ठ displaying, राजन् king, विकत्थसे bluster, महाप्रभावाः of great valour, नगर्जन्ति not shout like that.

40016443.author: Translation
40016443.content: Saumithri, not surprised at the screaming of Ravana with his projected teeth, said, "You are great in sinful action. People of great valour do not display such bluster. Do not shout like that."

40016444.author: पदार्थः
40016444.content: राक्षसेन्द्र Rakshasa king तव your, वीर्यम् valour, बलम् strength, प्रतापंच and heroism, पराक्रमंच and prowess, जानामि not known to me, अहम् I am, शरचापपाणिः arrow and bow in hand, अवस्थितः stand firmly, आगच्छ come on, मोघविकत्थेन by bragging, किम What.

40016444.author: Translation
40016444.content: "Your valour, heroism, strength and prowess are known to me. I stand firmly with bow and arrow come on. What is the use of bragging"

40016445.author: पदार्थः
40016445.content: एवम् in that manner, उक्तः having said, सःरक्षोधिपः that Lord of Rakshasas, कुपितः angrily, सुपुङ्खान् beautiful plumes, सप्त seven, शरान् arrows, ससर्ज released, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, काञ्चनमित्रपुङ्खैः gold shafted, निशिताग्रधारैः sharp pointed and sharp headed, बाणैः arrows, तान् them, चिच्छेद tore to pieces.

40016445.author: Translation
40016445.content: Lakshmana, having spoken in that manner, the Lord of Rakshasas released seven arrows with beautiful plumes. Lakshmana tore them into pieces with sharp pointed and sharpheaded arrows with gold shafts.

40016446.author: पदार्थः
40016446.content: सहसा with force, निकृत्तान् broken down, निकृत्तभोगान् whose coils have been broken, पन्नगेन्द्रानिव like serpent Lords, तान् them, प्रेक्षमाणः seeing, लङ्केश्वरः Lord of Lanka, क्रोधवशम् overtaken by wrath, जगाम fallen down, अन्यान् other, निशितान् sharp, पृषत्कान् let go.

40016446.author: Translation
40016446.content: Seeing the arrows cut down with force broken pieces like coils of serpents, the Lord of Lanka overtaken by anger let go another sharp arrow.

40016447.author: पदार्थः
40016447.content: सःरामानुजः that Rama's brother, कार्मुसम्प्रयुक्तम् stretching the bow into a round shape, तीव्रम् piercing, बाणवर्षम् rain of arrows, ववर्ष showered, क्षुरार्थचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णिभल्लैः Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan, शरान् च arrows, चिच्छेद tore, चचुक्षुभेच not perturbed.

40016447.author: Translation
40016447.content: The brother of Rama stretched his bow into a circle and showered rain of piercing arrows. He tore the arrows of his enemy with his arrows Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan without nay, perturbance.

40016448.author: पदार्थः
40016448.content: सः he, त्रिदशारिराजः Ravana the enemy of gods, मोघानि in effective, तानितानि all of them, बाणजालानि stream of arrows, पश्यन् seeing, लक्ष्मणलाघवेन Lakshman's skill, विसिस्मिये astonished, पुनःच again and, निशितान् sharp, बाणान् arrows, मुमोच let go.

40016448.author: Translation
40016448.content: Ravana, the enemy of gods seeing all his streams of arrows ineffective, was astonished at Lakshmana's skill, and let go sharp arrows again and again.

40016449.author: पदार्थः
40016449.content: महेन्द्रतुल्यः comparable to Mahendra, सः he, लक्ष्मणश्चापि Lakshmana also, शिताग्रान् sharp pointed, अशनितुल्यवेगान् flying at high speed, ज्वलनप्रकाशान् shining like fire, शरान् arrows, चापे bow, सन्धाय fitting, रक्षोधिपतेः Lord of Rakshasas, वधाय to put an end, ससर्ज loosed.

40016449.author: Translation
40016449.content: Lakshmana also, who is comparable to Mahendra, fitting his bow and arrows that shone like fire released sharp and pointed arrows to put an end to Rakshasa king.

40016450.author: पदार्थः
40016450.content: सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, छित्वा broken, तान् those, चतान् arrows, प्रचिच्छेदहि covered, कालाग्निसमप्रभेण bright as the fire at universal destruction, स्वयम्भुदत्तेन given by Brahma, शरेण by arrow, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana's, ललाटदेशे forehead, आजघान struck.

40016450.author: Translation
40016450.content: The Rakshasa king broke into pieces those arrows of Lakshmana and struck him on the forehead with the arrow gifted to him by Brahma, that was bright like the fire at the time of universal destruction.

40016451.author: पदार्थः
40016451.content: सःलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, रावणसायकार्तः hurt by Ravana's dart, चापम् bow, शिथिलम् feebly, प्रगृह्य seizing, चचाल shaken, पुनःच and again, कृच्छ्रात् with great difficulty, संज्ञाम् regaining consciousness, प्रतिलभ्य back in return, त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः enemy of Indra, चापम् dart, चिच्छेद tore to pieces

40016451.author: Translation
40016451.content: Lakshmana hurt by Ravana's dart, shaken up, seizing the bow feebly with great difficulty regaining consciousness tore the bow of the enemy of Indra into pieces in return.

40016452.author: पदार्थः
40016452.content: दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha, तदा then, निकृत्तचापम् bow cut into pieces, शिताग्रैः sharp and pointed tops, त्रिभिः three, बाणैः arrows, आजघान taking, सःराजा that king, सायकार्तः bow, पुनः again, कृच्छ्रात् with great difficulty, संज्ञाम् swooned, आससादंच and recovered.

40016452.author: Translation
40016452.content: Then Lakshmana son of Dasaratha, struck the bow of the king into pieces with three sharp and pointed arrows. The king swooned and recovered with great difficulty.

40016453.author: पदार्थः
40016453.content: कृत्तचापः bow being cut, शरताडितश्च hurt by the arrows, मेदार्द्रगात्रः limbs splattered with fat, रुधिरावसिक्तः bathed in blood, स्वयम् his own, उग्रशक्तिः formidable energy, सः he, देवशत्रुः enemy of god, युधि in the battlefield, स्वयम्भुदत्ताम् gifted by the self born, शक्तिम् javelin जग्राह seized.

40016453.author: Translation
40016453.content: Hurt by the arrows, bow cut, bathed in blood, limbs splattered with fat, Ravana the enemy of gods, himself being endowed with formidable energy gifted by the Self born creator seized javelin on the battlefield.

40016454.author: पदार्थः
40016454.content: राक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः Lord of the world of Rakshasas, सः he, सधूमानलसन्निकाशाम् like fire without smoke, संयति similar, वानराणाम् Vanaras, वित्रासनीम् create fear, ज्वलन्तीम् emitting fire, तांशक्तिम् that javelin, तरसा instantly, सौमित्रये on Saumithri, चिक्षेप flung.

40016454.author: Translation
40016454.content: The Lord of the world of Rakshasas instantly flung javelin, emitting fire without smoke, on Saumithri, which created fear among Vanaras.

40016455.author: पदार्थः
40016455.content: भरतानुजः Bharata's brother, Lakshmana, अपतन्तीम् coming towards, ताम् that, अस्त्रै: weapon, हुताग्निकल्पैः with shafts like flames of fire fuelled by ghee, बाणैश्च dart, जघान coming, तथापि even so, साशक्तिः that javelin, दाशरथेः Lakshmana, विशालम् broad, भुजान्तरम् chest, विवेश entered.

40016455.author: Translation
40016455.content: Lakshmana, the brother of Bharata struck the fierce weapon coming towards him like flames of fire fuelled by ghee, even then it struck him on his broad chest.

40016456.author: पदार्थः
40016456.content: शक्तिसमाहतःसन् badly hurt by the javelin, शक्तिम् powerful, सः he, रघुप्रवीरः eminent hero of Raghu's, मुहुः many a times, प्रजज्वाल burnt, राजा king, सहसा violently, अभ्युपेत्य caught, विह्वलन्तम् losing consciousness, तम् him, तरसा speedily, भुजाभ्याम् shoulders, जग्राह held.

40016456.author: Translation
40016456.content: Lakshmana the eminent hero of Raghu's was badly hurt by the javelin and was burning in pain. King Ravana caught him who was losing consciousness, violently and held him by his shoulders.

40016457.author: पदार्थः
40016457.content: हिमवान् Himalayas, मन्दरः Mandara, मेरुः Meru, सहामरैः Devatas, त्रैलोक्यंवा even the three worlds, भुजाभ्याम् shoulders, उद्धर्तुम् to lift, शक्यम् possible, भरतानुजः Lakshmana, नसङ् ख्यः not possible.

40016457.author: Translation
40016457.content: It may be possible to lift Himalayas, Mandara, Meru mountains or even the Devatas of the three worlds but not possible to lift Lakshmana by shoulders.

40016458.author: पदार्थः
40016458.content: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, ब्राह्म्या shoulders, शक्त्या by the javelin, स्तनान्तरे in the chest, ताडितास्तु wounded, विष्णोः Vishnu, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, स्वम् him, आत्मानम् own self, अनुस्मरत् recalled.

40016458.author: Translation
40016458.content: Even though Saumithri was wounded in the chest and the power of Brahma entered (into his chest) he recalled himself as an inconceivable form of Vishnu.

40016459.author: पदार्थः
40016459.content: ततः thereafter, देवकण्टकः enemy of Devatas, तम् him, दानवदर्पघ्नम् pride of Rakshasas, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, पीडयित्वा capable of crushing, लङ्घने to lift, प्रभुः king, नाभवत् not do.

40016459.author: Translation
40016459.content: Thereafter, Ravana the enemy of Devatas was not capable of lifting Lakshmana's shoulders. Lakshmana could crush the pride of Rakshasas.

40016460.author: पदार्थः
40016460.content: अथ and then, क्रुद्धः angry, वायुसुतः son of wind god, रावणम् Ravana, समभिद्रवत् came towards, क्रुद्धः angry, वज्रकल्पेन by thunderbolt, मुष्टिना fist, उरसि on the chest, आजघान struck.

40016460.author: Translation
40016460.content: Then the son of the wind god, enraged, came towards Ravana. Full of anger, he struck him with his thunderbolt like fist on the chest of Ravana.

40016461.author: पदार्थः
40016461.content: तेन by that, मुष्टिप्रहारेण blow of the fist, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa Lord, रावणः Ravana, चचाल shaken, जानुभ्याम् on his knees, भूमौ on the ground, अपतत् च fell.

40016461.author: Translation
40016461.content: By the blow of Hanuman's fist, Ravana the Lord of Rakshasas was shaken and fell on the ground on his knees.

40016462.author: पदार्थः
40016462.content: आस्यैःच from the mouth, नेत्रैः eyes, श्रवणैः ears, बहु much, रुधिरम् blood, पपात flowed, विघूर्णमानः rolling, निश्चेष्टः still, रथोपस्थे hind part, उपाविशत् sank.

40016462.author: Translation
40016462.content: Much blood flowed from his(Ravana's) mouth, ears, and eyes. Rolling in the hind part of the chariot he became still and sank.

40016463.author: पदार्थः
40016463.content: विसंज्ञः lost senses, मूर्छितश्च unconscious, आसीन्न perturbed, स्थानम् location, नचसमालभत् not knowing, समरे in the combat, भीमविक्रमम् fierce valour, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, ऋषयः sages, वानराश्चैव Vanaras also, सवासवाःसह demons also, देवाश्चैव even Devatas, नेदुः shouted in joy.

40016463.author: Translation
40016463.content: Ravana of fierce valour having lost senses and waking up from unconscious state, perturbed, did not know where he was. Seeing this the sages, even Vanaras, the demons as well as Devatas shouted in joy.

40016464.author: पदार्थः
40016464.content: अथ and, तेजस्वी brilliant, हनूमानपि Hanuman, रावणार्धितम् wounded by Ravana, तंलक्ष्मणम् that Lakshmana, बाहुभ्याम् both shoulders, परिगृह्य holding, राघूभ्याशम् near Rama, आनयत् brought.

40016464.author: Translation
40016464.content: Brilliant Hanuman holding Lakshmana wounded by Ravana in both shoulders brought him to Rama.

40016465.author: पदार्थः
40016465.content: सः he, शत्रूणाम् for the enemies, अप्रकम्पःअपि unshakeable by enemies, वायुसूनोः son of wind god, सुहृत्त्वेन friend, परमया highly, भक्त्याच being devoted, कपेः monkey, लघुत्वम् became light, आगमत् became.

40016465.author: Translation
40016465.content: Lakshmana though unshakeable for enemies, became light for the son of wind god by his friendship and high devotion.

40016466.author: पदार्थः
40016466.content: साशक्तिः that power, युधि in war, दुर्जयम् vanquish, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, रावणस्य Ravana's, तस्मिन् रथे in his chariot, पुनः again, स्थानम् position, उपागता returning back.

40016466.author: Translation
40016466.content: That power returned back to Ravana's chariot to its position, leaving Lakshmana, who was difficult to vanquish.

40016467.author: पदार्थः
40016467.content: शत्रुसूदनः could destroy foes, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अमीमांस्यम् immeasurable, विष्णोःभागम् part of Vishnu, आत्मानम् himself, प्रत्यनुस्मरन् again remembering, आश्वस्तःच from consciousness, विशल्यःच relieved of wounds.

40016467.author: Translation
40016467.content: Lakshmana who could destroy foes, recovering from unconsciousness, relieved of wounds again remembered himself to be part of Vishnu of immeasurable power.

40016468.author: पदार्थः
40016468.content: महातेजाः of mighty prowess, रावणोऽपि Ravana too, महाहवे huge combat संज्ञाम् waking up, प्राप्य endured, निशितान् sharp, बाणान् arrows, आददे, महत् great, धनुःच bow also, आददे took over.

40016468.author: Translation
40016468.content: Ravana of mighty prowess waking up from consciousness took over his sharp arrows and the great bow also.

40016469.author: पदार्थः
40016469.content: राघवस्तु Raghava also, रणे in the combat, निपातितमहावीराम् fallen heroes, द्रवन्तीम् struck down, वानरीम् Vanaras, चमूम् leaders, दृष्टवा seeing, रावणम् Ravana, समभिद्रवत् assailed.

40016469.author: Translation
40016469.content: Raghava also assailed Ravana seeing the fallen Vanara heroes struck in the combat.

40016470.author: पदार्थः
40016470.content: अथ and then, हनूमान् Hanuman, एनम् , उपसङ्गम्य submitted, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, विष्णुः Vishnu, गरुत्मन्तम् Garuda, बलवंन्तं mighty, समाहितः mounted, यथा so also, मम my, पृष्ठम् back, समारुह्य mounting, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, शास्तुम् subdue, अर्हसि ought to.

40016470.author: Translation
40016470.content: And then Hanuman submitted to Rama, "Just as Lord Vishnu mounted on mighty Garuda, you should also be mounted on my back and subdue Ravana."

40016471.author: पदार्थः
40016471.content: अथ and then, हनूमान् Hanuman, एनम् , उपसङ्गम्य submitted, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, विष्णुः Vishnu, गरुत्मन्तम् Garuda, बलवंन्तं mighty, समाहितः mounted, यथा so also, मम my, पृष्ठम् back, समारुह्य mounting, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, शास्तुम् subdue, अर्हसि ought to.

40016471.author: Translation
40016471.content: And then Hanuman submitted to Rama, "Just as Lord Vishnu mounted on mighty Garuda, you should also be mounted on my back and subdue Ravana."

40016472.author: पदार्थः
40016472.content: राघवः Raghava, वायुपुत्रेण to the son of wind god, भाषितम् spoken, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, आरुरोहमहाशूरं climbed on the hero, महाकपिम् great monkey, बलवन्तम् strong, आरुरोह on climbing, मनुजाधिपः Lord of humans, सङ् ख्ये in war, रथस्थम् on the chariot, रावणम् Ravana, ददर्श saw.

40016472.author: Translation
40016472.content: On hearing the sub mission of Hanuman, Sri Rama, the Lord of humans climbed on the great monkey and saw Ravana on the chariot.

40016473.author: पदार्थः
40016473.content: महातेजाः highly energetic, सः he, तम् him, आलोक्य beheld, क्रुद्धः furious, अभ्युद्यतायुधः rushed towards, विष्णुः Vishnu, वैरोचनिव like Virochana, राघवः Raghava, प्रदुद्राव wielding bow.

40016473.author: Translation
40016473.content: Beholding Ravana, highly energetic Rama wielding his bow went furiously towards him just as Lord Vishnu went with his discuss against Virochana.

40016474.author: पदार्थः
40016474.content: रामः Rama, वज्रनिष्पेषनिस्वनम् like the clap of thunder sound, तीव्रम् intense, ज्याशब्दम् echoing the sound, अकरोत् caused, गम्भीरया majestic, गिरा in deep voice, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, उवाचह spoke.

40016474.author: Translation
40016474.content: Rama created a sound like a clap of thunder ringing intensely, a majestic one and spoke in a deep voice to the king.

40016475.author: पदार्थः
40016475.content: राक्षसशार्दूल tiger among Rakshasas, तिष्ठतिष्ठ forbear, त्वम् you, मम to me, ईदृशम् such, विप्रियम् delivered, कृत्वा having done, क्वनु where, गत्वा going, मोक्षम् deliverance, अवाप्स्यसि after the offence.

40016475.author: Translation
40016475.content: "Oh! Tiger among Rakshasas, forbear, forbear. Having done such an offence to me, where are you going for deliverance"

40016476.author: पदार्थः
40016476.content: इन्द्रवैवस्वतभास्करान्वा either to Indra, or Yama or sun god, स्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशंकरान्वा to selfborn Brahma or to fire god or Shankara, दशवा ten, दिशोवा directions, त्वम् you, गमिष्यसियदि even if you run, तथापि like that, अद्य front, मे of me, गतः gone, नविमोक्ष्यसे not escape.

40016476.author: Translation
40016476.content: "If you go to Indra or Yama or Sun God or the selfborn Brahma or fire God or Shankara or the ten directions like that, and if you run in front of me you cannot escape."

40016477.author: पदार्थः
40016477.content: रक्षोगणराज king of Rakshasa troop, अद्य in front, यःएषः he who like that, त्वया by you, शक्त्या support, अभिहतः struck now, विषादम् sorrow, इच्छन् , सःएव he himself, सहसा now, अभ्युपेत्य come, अद्य in front, युद्धे to combat, सपुत्रपौत्रस्य sons and grandsons, तव your, मृत्युः death.

40016477.author: Translation
40016477.content: "Oh! king of Rakshasa troop! He, who was struck without support now, even if he were to come now in front, you with your sons and grandsons will be struck to death by him."

40016478.author: पदार्थः
40016478.content: एतेन by me, अद्भुतदर्शनानि of fierce form, जनस्थानकृतालयानि taken abode at Janasthana, अत्तवरायुधानि used choicest weapons, चतुर्धशानि fourteen, रक्षःसहस्राणि thousands of Rakshasas, शरैः weapons, निषूदितानि were destroyed by me.

40016478.author: Translation
40016478.content: "By me, who is your adversary, fourteen thousand Rakshasas of fierce forms, who had taken abode at Janasthana and used choicest weapons were exterminated."

40016479.author: पदार्थः
40016479.content: महाबलः mighty strong, राक्षसेन्द्रः Lord of Rakshasas, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, महता violent, रोषेण anger, आविष्टः seized with, पूर्ववैरम् earlier enmity, अनुस्मरन् recalling, रणे in combat, राघवम् Raghava, वहन्तम् struck, महावेगम् at high speed, वायुपुत्रम् son of wind god, कालानलशिखोपमैः like tongues of fire at universal destruction, दीप्स्सैः blazing, शरैः darts, आजघान discharged.

40016479.author: Translation
40016479.content: On hearing Raghava's words, the mighty strong king of Rakshasas seized with violent anger, recalling earlier enmity, struck with blazing arrows like tongues of fire at the time of universal destruction while Hanuman bore Rama.

40016480.author: पदार्थः
40016480.content: महाबलः mighty strong, राक्षसेन्द्रः Lord of Rakshasas, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, महता violent, रोषेण anger, आविष्टः seized with, पूर्ववैरम् earlier enmity, अनुस्मरन् recalling, रणे in combat, राघवम् Raghava, वहन्तम् struck, महावेगम् at high speed, वायुपुत्रम् son of wind god, कालानलशिखोपमैः like tongues of fire at universal destruction, दीप्स्सैः blazing, शरैः darts, आजघान discharged.

40016480.author: Translation
40016480.content: On hearing Raghava's words, the mighty strong king of Rakshasas seized with violent anger, recalling earlier enmity, struck with blazing arrows like tongues of fire at the time of universal destruction while Hanuman bore Rama.

40016481.author: पदार्थः
40016481.content: राक्षसेन by the Rakshasa, आहवे discharged, सायकैः arrows, ताडितस्यापि when hurt him also, स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य by nature endowed with energy, तस्य his, तेजः energy, भूयः exceedingly, अभ्यवर्धत went on increasing.

40016481.author: Translation
40016481.content: Even though Hanuman was hurt by the arrows discharged by the Rakshasa king, being endowed with energy by nature, his energy went on increasing.

40016482.author: पदार्थः
40016482.content: ततः then, महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, रामः Rama, रावणेन Ravana, कृतव्रणम् wounds caused, प्लवगशार्दूलम् tiger among monkeys, दृष्टवा seeing, क्रोधस्य in anger, वशम् seized, एयिवान् possibly.

40016482.author: Translation
40016482.content: Seeing the wounds caused by Ravana to Hanuman, the tiger among monkeys, possibly Rama was seized with anger.

40016483.author: पदार्थः
40016483.content: रामः Rama, अभिसङ्क्रम्य advancing forward, तस्य his, सचक्रम् the wheel of chariot, साश्वध्वजच्छत्रमहापताकम् horses, standard, canopy, ससारथिम् the charioteer, साशनिशूलखडगम् tridents and weapons, रथम् chariot, शरैः darts, पुङ्खैः swords, प्रचिच्छेद tore into pieces.

40016483.author: Translation
40016483.content: Advancing towards him, (Ravana), Rama tore into pieces his chariot, wheels, horses, standard and canopy including the charioteer and the darts and swords.

40016484.author: पदार्थः
40016484.content: अथ and, वज्राशनिसन्निभेन resembling thunderbolt in shining, बाणेन arrows, इन्द्रशत्रुम् weapon of Indra, तरसा sharp, व्यूढसुजातरूपे broad fine looking chest,भुजान्तरे in between the shoulders, भगवान् divine, इन्द्रः Indra, वज्रेण with thunderbolt, मेरुम् इव like the Meru mountain, जघान struck.

40016484.author: Translation
40016484.content: Then with a shining thunderbolt like arrows Rama struck with the weapon of Indra into the fine chest in between the shoulders just as Indra would strike the Meru Mountain with his thunderbolt.

40016485.author: पदार्थः
40016485.content: यः he, राजा king, वज्रपाताशनिसन्निपातात् one who is not disturbed hit by thunderbolt or by lightning, नचुक्षुभे not disturbed, नापिचचाल arrow, सः he, वीरः hero, रामबाणाभिहतः struck by Rama's arrow, भृशार्तः reeled, चचाल agonized, चापंच bow also, मुमोच let go.

40016485.author: Translation
40016485.content: He, that heroic king, who was not disturbed hurt by thunderbolt of lightning, was agonized when struck by Rama's arrow and let his bow fall.

40016486.author: पदार्थः
40016486.content: रामः Rama, विह्वलन्तम् swooning, तम् him, प्रसमीक्ष्य seeing, अथ then, दीप्तम् flaming, अर्थचन्द्रम् crescent shaped, समाददे took up, तेन by that, महात्मा great soul, सहसा hastily, अर्कवर्णम् red like sun, किरीटम् crown, चिच्छेद broke into pieces.

40016486.author: Translation
40016486.content: Seeing Ravana swooning, great soul Rama took up a crescent shaped arrow and hastily broke his crown into pieces which were shining bright red like the Sun.

40016487.author: पदार्थः
40016487.content: रामः Rama, युधि in combat, निर्विषाशीविषसन्निकाशम् resembling a serpent rid of poison without his crown, शान्तार्चिषम् without splendour, सूर्यमिव like sun, अप्रकाशम् without brightness, गतश्रियम् glory lost, कृत्तकिरीटकूटम् crown being torn, तंराक्षसेन्द्रम् that king of Rakshasas, उवाच said.

40016487.author: Translation
40016487.content: Rama said to the king of Rakshasas, who was like a serpent rid of poison without (head) crown, without splendour like the Sun without brightness, his glory lost with the crown broken in the combat.

40016488.author: पदार्थः
40016488.content: त्वया by you, सुभीमम् exceedingly difficult, महत् great, कर्म task, कृतम् done, त्वया by you, अहम् I, हतप्रवीरः mighty heroes killed, कृतःच done, तस्मात् therefore, परिशान्तःइति exhausted, व्यवस्य declare, त्वाम् you, मृत्युवशम् to death, ननयामि not sent.

40016488.author: Translation
40016488.content: A great task of killing mighty heroes has been accomplished by you. Therefore, you are exhausted. I declare that I will not send you to death.

40016489.author: पदार्थः
40016489.content: रात्रिंचरराज king of night rangers, जानामि I know, त्वम् you, रणार्धितः are agonized after war, गच्छ go, लङ्काम् to Lanka, प्रविश्य reenter, अश्वस्य resting, रथी chariot, धन्वीच and bow, निर्याहि depart, तदा then, रथस्थः mounted on chariot, मे my, बलम् strength, प्रेक्ष्यसि witness.

40016489.author: Translation
40016489.content: "King of night rangers! I know you are agonized after the war. Go to Lanka and rest and reenter, mounted on your chariot with bow. You will witness my strength."

40016490.author: पदार्थः
40016490.content: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, सः by him, हतदर्पहर्षः vanity and joy crushed, निकृत्तचापः bow broken into pieces, हताश्वसूतः horses and charioteer killed, शरार्धितः wounded by arrows, कृत्तमहाकिरीटः crown broken, सःराजा that king, सहसा hastily, लङ्काम् Lanka, विवेश entered.

40016490.author: Translation
40016490.content: Rama having spoken in that way (consoling), the king with his vanity and pride crushed, bow broken into pieces, horses and charioteer killed, wounded by arrows, crown broken entered Lanka hastily.

40016491.author: पदार्थः
40016491.content: महाबले endowed with great prowess, दानवदेवशत्रौ enemy of Danavas and Devas, तस्मिन् his, रजनीचरेन्द्रे king night prowlers, प्रविष्टे entering, रामः Rama, परमाहवाग्रे in the forefront, लक्ष्मणेनसह with Lakshmana, हरीन् monkeys ', विशल्यान् removed, चकार went.

40016491.author: Translation
40016491.content: After the king of prowlers, the enemy of Danavas and Devas entered Lanka, Rama and Lakshmana also drew out the arrows from monkeys in the forefront of the battlefield and went.

40016492.author: पदार्थः
40016492.content: त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रौ enemy of Indra, तस्मिन् his, प्रभन्ने having been routed, सुरासुराः suras and Asuras, भूतगणाः guardians, दिशश्च of four quarters, हसागराः including sea, सर्षिमहोरगाःच including the sages and serpents, तथैव so also, भूम्यम्बुचराः creatures of land and water, प्रहृष्टाः joyful.

40016492.author: Translation
40016492.content: The enemy of Indra having been routed, the suras and asuras, the guardians of the four quarters, including the sea, the large serpents, and sages so also the creatures of land and water were joyful. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
